newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Dhaka will moot proposal for a sub-regional cooperation, grouping Bangladesh, India, Nepal and Bhutan, at the SAARC foreign ministers' meeting beginning in New Delhi on Thursday.

Preparations are underway for dialogue on Saturday between tribal Shantibahini insurgents and the National Committee on Chittagong Hill Tracts, formed by the new government, government officials said.

Secretary General of opposition BNP Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan on Wednesday urged the ruling party to create a "congenial atmosphere" for dialogue to break the political stand-off and make way for his party's return to parliament.
Finance MInister S A M S Kibria has invited the opposition for a dialogue to thrash out the obstacles in implementing the economic reforms.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Wednesday felicitated Kofi Annan, Secretary General designate of the United Nations.
Hong Kong Bank, one of the World's largest banks based in Britain, opened a branch in Dhaka on Tuesday.
Revenue to the tune of 150 million taka is siphoned off every month only from the power and gas utilities in capital Dhaka, an adiviser to the last caretaker government disclosed on Wednesday.
